verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs claim document creation and refinement: Copilot in Word lets you prompt, upload notes, and refine in chat; PowerPoint goes from prompt to presentation; Excel lets you tweak via chat; and Copilot can run code to generate graphs. A hands-on trial report concretely contradicts the iterative-editing claim: Copilot in Word could only append to the end of the document, could not create tables or search and replace, and did not keep formatting. missing for 10: independent confirmation that iterative in-place editing works, explicit export or download documentation, and clarity on whether file creation works in the standalone Copilot app versus only inside the Office apps.
